description: Six regional soil-survey publications explicitly discuss irrigation suitability or development. They cover the St.Mary/Milk rivers irrigation project, Cardston, Pincher Creek–Crowsnest Pass, Forty Mile and the southeast/southwest Gleichen sheets. The project report describes soil/topography maps, analytical profiles and land-levelling, salinity and drainage issues. Other reports provide irrigation-capability interpretations alongside general agricultural uses. PDF reports and JPEG map descriptors are listed; Cardston also has an unspecified supplementary ZIP.
